conversation_pain_points: bot repeated insulin advice after correction
output.summary: The user asked why morning glucose readings were around 160–180 despite taking metformin at night, walking after dinner, and reducing rice; daytime readings were lower. The assistant repeatedly raised insulin as an option after the user clarified they did not take it, and the user pushed back on repeated doctor referrals and repeated lifestyle advice. The assistant suggested a 3 a.m. glucose check and ended by recommending the user discuss the results and metformin formulation with a doctor; the user said they understood and thanked the assistant.
